section.p: Consider a "Install Application Server" chapter in an "Enterprise Deployment Guide" document where one procedural step requires multiple dependent actions that must be completed in sequence.
section.codeblock:
Install and initialize the application server on a Linux host.

Ensure that Java 17 and administrator privileges are available on the target server.

Download the application server installation package.

The installation package is available in the local downloads directory.

Install the application server package. Extract the installation archive to /opt/appserver. Run the initialization script: ./initialize.sh. Start the application server service.

The application server starts successfully and listens on port 8080.

The application server is installed and ready for deployment.
section.p: Result: Use <substeps> when a single procedural step contains smaller dependent actions that must occur in a fixed sequence to complete the parent step.
